item.title: Cisco Unified Communications Manager WebDialer SSRF → Arbitrary File Write → Root (CVE-2026-20230)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 8.6) — network · CVE-2026-20230 (cisco-sa-cucm-ssrf-cXPnHcW). Status: PoC — scanner/tester confirms the WebDialer precondition and SSRF reachability. Affects: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM) and Unified CM Session Management Edition (SME) — WebDialer service. Tags: cisco, unified-communications-manager, ucm, webdialer, ssrf, cwe-918, unauthenticated, remote, privilege-escalation, kev, actively-exploited.
